# Headers the generated game code includes (directly or through ps2_runtime.h, ps2_syscalls.h, ps2_stubs.h,
# ps2_log.h, ps2_runtime_macros.h). Changing any of them recompiles every generated file: a 35-40 minute rebuild.
# build.ps1 stops before such a rebuild unless it is approved (games\edit-approved.txt, valid 3 hours) or
# -AllowFullRebuild is passed. One path per line, relative to the repository root; '*' and '**' wildcards allowed.
